note: trained and exported for this count (2026-10-20); the checkpoint (cifar_cnn.pt), the export (export/) and the wrapper scripts that ran the repository's cifar/train_cifar.py and cifar/quantize_cifar.py unchanged are in bankperm/cifar_net/

data.source: Hugging Face dataset uoft-cs/cifar10, plain_text parquet (PNG bytes), converted to uint8 arrays; no pickle from the download was loaded for training

official_test_set_check.what: the npz test images and labels are identical, image by image and in order, to the official CIFAR-10 test_batch (www.cs.toronto.edu/~kriz/cifar-10-python.tar.gz)
official_test_set_check.also: --data with run_cifar.load_cifar_test on the official test_batch gives the same fits, classes and per-image totals on the first 200 images

training.script: cifar/train_cifar.py main(), unchanged, run through a wrapper that replaces torchvision.datasets.CIFAR10 by the same images from npz and computes Net in channels_last
training.args: --epochs 15 --workers 1 (defaults otherwise: batch 128, SGD lr 0.1 momentum 0.9 nesterov, weight decay 5e-4, OneCycleLR, RandomCrop 32 pad 4 + horizontal flip); CPU only
training.epochs_note: 15 epochs instead of the script default 60, to fit the time box
training.model_selection: train_cifar.py keeps the epoch with the best TEST accuracy (here the last, 15)

quantization.script: cifar/quantize_cifar.py main(), unchanged, same wrapper, defaults (--calib 512: activation ranges from the first 512 TEST images, as the script does)
